name: Pi
description: The Pi coding agent driven over its RPC mode. Pi reaches models only through the provider gateway, so it needs a provider configured under Settings → Providers and no Claude login.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model Pi runs on, as <provider>/<model> for a provider configured under Settings → Providers. Pi reaches models only through the provider gateway, so there is no working default; an empty value stops the colony with instructions.

effort.title: Thinking level
effort.description: Reasoning effort passed to Pi as --thinking: minimal to max. Empty runs the model without thinking; off is the same, stated explicitly.
